summary: This directory serves as the root entry point for a static analysis system, providing the necessary infrastructure to manage TypeScript projects and the high-level orchestration required to perform file-level analysis and data persistence.
responsibilities: Provide a unified entry point for analysis and project management utilities.
Expose core interfaces for static analysis operations.
Facilitate access to project identification and file system utilities.
relationships: The root exports connect the analysis pipeline to the underlying project infrastructure.
Shared utilities provide the foundational environment required by the analysis orchestration layer to operate consistently.
Project management tools define the workspace boundaries that the analysis pipeline processes.
designDecisions: Re-exporting modules to create a clean public API surface.
Decoupling analysis logic from project discovery mechanisms.
Centralizing access to internal modules for easier integration and maintenance.
